description: This is a Java unit test file for the class 'ThingId', testing its immutability, equality, exception cases, dummy identification, string representation, namespace and name accessors, random generation, and instance identity.

classes.name: ThingIdTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for 'ThingId'. It contains multiple test cases verifying immutability, equality, exception handling, dummy checks, string representation, and getter methods.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that 'ThingId' instances are immutable and that 'NamespacedEntityId' is also immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to ensure 'ThingId' properly implements equals and hashCode.

methods.name: dummyIsDummy
methods.description: Checks that the dummy 'ThingId' instance reports as dummy.

methods.name: manuallyCreatedDummyIsDummy
methods.description: Checks that manually created 'ThingId's with specific patterns are identified as dummy.

methods.name: validThingIdIsNoDummy
methods.description: Verifies that valid 'ThingId's are not considered dummy.

methods.name: toStringConcatenatesNamespaceAndName
methods.description: Checks that 'toString()' on 'ThingId' concatenates namespace and name appropriately.

methods.name: returnsCorrectNamespace
methods.description: Verifies that 'getNamespace()' returns the correct namespace.

methods.name: returnsCorrectName
methods.description: Verifies that 'getName()' returns the correct name.

methods.name: generateRandomHasEmptyNamespace
methods.description: Ensures that 'generateRandom()' creates a 'ThingId' with an empty namespace.

methods.name: thingIdOfThingIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks that creating a 'ThingId' from an existing 'ThingId' returns the same instance (identity).
